name: Furlbrow's Deed
summary: Beside their broken wagon near Westfall's border, Theodore and Verna Furlbrow have lost their farm to the Defias Brotherhood. Their land deed is in bandit hands, and with it went their home and livelihood.

sections.title: Stolen Land and Forged Claims
sections.body: Theodore Furlbrow and Verna signed the deed to secure their family farm in Westfall. After the Defias Brotherhood overran the region, bandits drove them from home and carried the deed into Elwynn Forest. Notes on its back show the thieves planned to copy it and forge claims to other properties. The Furlbrows lost their livelihood and took to the road, with no home to return to.

faq.q: Why did the Defias steal the deed?
aliases: why did bandits want the deed
faq.answer: Notes on the deed show the Defias meant to study its seal and signatures, then forge claims to seized homesteads across Westfall.

faq.q: Who does this deed belong to?
faq.answer: The deed belongs to Farmer Theodore Furlbrow and his wife Verna. Outlaws drove the Westfall homesteaders from their farm.

faq.q: Where can the Furlbrows be found?
faq.answer: You can find Theodore and Verna just inside Westfall, beside their broken wagon on the main road from Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why do the Furlbrows still care about the deed if they fled?
aliases: why do they want deed back
faq.answer: The Furlbrows know Westfall is too dangerous for honest folk now. Still, proof of ownership gives them hope of reclaiming their land if peace returns.

angles.text: As a human, you can see how the Defias have damaged civil order in the lands beside Stormwind, even by stealing simple property titles.
As an Alliance member, you can bring a little comfort to people driven from their homes while the kingdom has too few soldiers.
